exam: 106年特種考試地方政府公務人員考試
subject: 觀光英語
classes: 觀光行政(選試觀光英語)

essays.text:
解釋名詞：請以英文解釋下列專有名詞。（每小題 4 分，共 20 分）
① Charter Flights
② A concierge (in a hotel)
③ Baggage Claim (in an airport)
④ Backpackers
⑤ Bed and Breakfast

問答題：請用英文作答。（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
① If a Taiwanese is going to travel abroad, you as a professional international tour guide,please list FIVE must-visit tourist spots in foreign countries and explain why youparticularly choose the five spots.
② If a foreign tourist is coming to visit Taiwan, you as a Taiwan’s local resident, pleaserecommend some food to eat (can be local snacks or food at night markets) and somesouvenirs (can be local specialty) to bring back home with. (Please recommend FIVEitems including food and souvenir all together.)

翻譯：請翻譯成英文。（每小題 10 分，共 20 分）
①外交部應該與地方政府密切合作，提出有利臺灣發展觀光的行銷策略，以有效推展臺灣觀光至全世界。
②我們處於地球村，而很多人為了各種目的在全世界旅行。觀光旅遊的收益，已成為世界上很多國家最重要的財政收入之一。

英文作文：請注意文章的內容、組織、字彙、句型、文法。（30 分）Please write an essay (about 300 words) in which you introduce FOUR Taiwan’smost important holidays and FOUR most important western holidays. Please describe indetail how Taiwanese and western people celebrate these holidays and compare thedifferences and similarities between our holidays and those western holidays.（請接背面）
